name: ADAM
description:
A.D.A.M. (Animated Direction And Movement) — A Roll20 API mod for directional token movement, token facing, movement states, and optional animated token side switching via rollable table tokens.

Select a token and use !adam --move <direction> to move it, !adam --face <direction> to set facing, !adam --state <state> to set a movement or combat state, or !adam --menu to open the control deck.

For instructions run `!adam --help` in game.

useroptions.name: grid-size
useroptions.description: Pixels per grid square on your map. The Roll20 default is 70.

useroptions.name: move-distance
useroptions.description: Number of grid squares to move per move command (1–20).

useroptions.name: auto-face
useroptions.description: Automatically rotate the token to face the movement direction.

useroptions.name: language
useroptions.description: Output language for chat messages. Supported locales: af, ca, zh-TW, cs, da, nl, en-US, fi, fr, de, el, he, hu, it, ja, ko, pl, pt-PT, pt-BR, ru, es, sv, tr, uk. Short aliases en, zh, pt are also accepted.
